name: mothership-night2
notes: Mothership night concept, ROUND TWO (Colby’s notes on the first night film, 2026-09-08 ~12:10): more fog; the ship sails forward like a real boat and never rises out of the water (K1 already carries it as a lantern glow in the fog); the rainbow shimmers like light; prettier moonlight; the rainbow’s reflection soft and broken. Three Seedance shots chained through the position-locked round-two keyframes as first and last frames, one continuous locked-off take, then black. Native sea ambience.

render.prompt: The moonlit, fog-covered night sea under a shimmering rainbow of light. Far away on the horizon, exactly under the apex, the faint warm glow of a ship’s lanterns deep in the fog slowly brightens and resolves into a tall three-masted 1800s ship of the line, tiny and bow-on, already on the water and sailing toward the camera through the fog; the fog rolls and thickens. Photoreal live-action night cinematography under a bright full moon, one continuous locked-off shot from just above the water, dead centre on the ship’s course; the camera does not move. The ship is a real ship on the water at all times: its hull sits in the sea and it simply sails forward toward the camera on a steady heading, never rising, never surfacing, never appearing from nothing, growing only by coming closer, always bow-on and exactly on the vertical centre line. Dense fog rolls continuously over the water; the rainbow shimmers softly like light; moonlight glitters on the swells and silvers the fog; the only warm light is the ship’s lanterns; soft halation, fine film grain; no people, no text, no logos. Ambient sound only: the sea at night, a low wind, the creak of rigging and a faint ship’s bell.
